asOf: World Economic Outlook (October 2026); Global Debt Database (Sep 2025)
note: IMF DataMapper. Government debt and GDP from the World Economic Outlook; recent years may be IMF staff estimates for some countries (DataMapper does not flag which). Household and non-financial corporate debt from the Global Debt Database (loans and debt securities). gov_debt_usd = gov_debt_gdp/100 x gdp_usd, computed by Orbis. Countries only; regional aggregates dropped. 3 significant figures.
